description: Scaffolds a new project folder from the harness templates and -- the load-bearing half -- registers it everywhere it must appear (the project ledger, any container index, its backup lane). Use when the user says "/new-project", "new project", "set up a project for X", or promotes an outgrown scratch folder to a project of its own. Do NOT use for adding a subfolder inside an existing project, or for work in a project that already has its CLAUDE.md and CHECKPOINT.md.
